أنتهك (form VIII)
# أَنْتَهِكُ (ʔantahiku) /ʔan.ta.hi.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# أُنْتَهَكُ (ʔuntahaku) /ʔun.ta.ha.ku/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# أَنْتَهِكَ (ʔantahika) /ʔan.ta.hi.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# أُنْتَهَكَ (ʔuntahaka) /ʔun.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
